title: A Note in the Stash
summary: Mara writes that the Blackwater Cartel's drug money pays the cult's keepers in the snow, the sand and the sea. The only way to their Don is from inside. Grow a sample of weed (Create: Addictives) and find the Fixer, who is hiring growers.

goals.say: The Fixer weighs the sample in one hand and you in the other. 'You'll do.'
goals.name: The Fixer

quest_book.title: A Note in the Stash
quest_book.author: Old Mara
pages:
Forgive me for this one.

The Blackwater Cartel pays the cult a third of everything. That money keeps the beasts' keepers fed. To reach their Don you must become one of them.

This note was in one of their stashes. - M.
If you found this, you know what the seeds are for.
The valley pays well for green. Grow some. Bring me a sample. Ask for the Fixer in any village two hills over.
Don't bring the guards. Don't bring the priest. Don't bring your conscience.

threats.name: The Fixer
threats.target_line: You're the one asking about work. Let's see what you grew.
talk: Hiring is a strong word. I'm finding out who can keep a field alive and their mouth shut.
Then Blackwater pays you better than any farm ever will.
threats.delivered_line: The Fixer weighs the sample in one hand and you in the other. 'You'll do.'
